triage.reason: Pinch stop took 13 ms against a 10 ms limit at -30 °C and 9 V. This is a late pinch stop, so it is a safety issue.
The window stops working about 50 s after ignition off, but retained power should last 60 s. The reporter is unsure of the spec, but the symptom is clear.
Period of 97 to 104 ms is within 100 ms ± 10 ms. Information only.
False reversal of express close in the cold with nothing in the window. The second try worked, but the function is wrong in normal use.
Comment typo only. The code is correct.
Same problem as DR-1001: late pinch stop (14 ms) at -30 °C with low supply.
Sleep current of 140 µA exceeds the 100 µA limit. The likely cause is the CAN transceiver staying in standby. There is no safety effect.
False reversal on rough road (2 of 10 tries) with nothing trapped.
Overcurrent does not store B1A02 and the fault state stays 0. The diagnostic function is lost.
Too vague to judge. Two clinic drivers reported a subjective slow reaction with no measurement. Provisional S3 until the response time is measured.
Same problem as DR-1004: false reversal in cold weather with no obstacle.
One open request still moves the window after the model passes 140 °C. The next request is refused. This is a limit miss with no safety effect.
Position at the top seal drifts to 3.5 mm after 200 cycles. This is degraded accuracy that builds up slowly.
Motor command stays on 180 ms after release at 16 V, against a limit of 100 ms. The overrun depends on voltage, so I assigned it to motor_drive. It is a limit miss at high voltage only.
Same problem as DR-1002: retained power ends before 60 s (about 45 s here).
One WLC_Status frame was missing during diagnostic requests (200 ms gap). The fault is rare and the function is degraded.
Documentation error in the draft manual only.
Hall signal loss is not detected, so there is no DTC and the motor runs to the end stop. Without a position signal, anti-pinch protection is lost.
Same problem as DR-1012: one opening is allowed above 140 °C.
Express close is available while the system is not normalized. This bypasses a safety restriction, because pinch protection depends on a valid position.
Unused variable and compiler warning only. There is no functional effect.
3 of 100 diagnostic responses took 55 to 62 ms against a 50 ms limit while the motor starts. This is a limit miss with no safety effect.
Same problem as DR-1008: false reversal on cobblestones.
Reverse polarity protection diode D3 failed open, and the controller is dead afterwards. This is a loss of function.
Undervoltage stop in 21 ms is within the 50 ms limit. Information only.
Loud knock at the end stop with no damage. The end-stop behaviour is degraded, and the report is partly subjective.
Same problem as DR-1018: Hall loss is not detected, no DTC is stored, and the motor keeps pushing.
No limit exists in the spec, so this is not a failure. It is a proposal for a new requirement.
Same problem as DR-1009: overcurrent leaves the fault state at 0 and fault memory empty.

Reversal distance is 146 mm at 85 °C, below the 150 mm limit. It passed at 23 °C with 162 mm. A short reversal in a pinch case could leave a person trapped, so I rated it as a safety issue. The limit direction is inferred from the numbers given.
